Class ClientSession

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.client.ClientSession
public class ClientSession extends Object
Utility class to manage the current client session state during a game. Stores data such as the current username, profile picture, player information, and session status flags.

    • getPlayerProfilePicture

      public static javafx.scene.layout.StackPane getPlayerProfilePicture(String username, double size)
      Builds and returns a circular profile picture for the given player. The picture is composed of a background, character body, and accessory, clipped to a circular shape.
      Parameters:
      username - the username of the player
      size - the desired size (width and height) of the profile picture
      Returns:
      a StackPane containing the composed profile picture, or null if the player does not exist
